This FloPlast MiniFlo uPVC half round gutter union in black provides a robust and reliable connection for two sections of 76mm guttering within a MiniFlo system. Constructed from durable uPVC, it is engineered for excellent weather resistance and longevity, ideal for exterior rainwater drainage on garages, sheds, summer houses, and various garden buildings. Installation is made simple and secure with pre-lubricated gutter seals ensuring a watertight fit and a pre-fitted retaining clip for a firm hold. This low maintenance component helps create efficient and long-lasting guttering systems.
